name: AI Mock Interview Preparation
desc: An AI-powered mock interview preparation platform using Gemini AI API. Features voice-interactive interviews with real-time feedback — built with Next.js, Vapi, and Firebase.

name: Blog Website
desc: A full-stack blog platform built using MERN stack with Appwrite backend. Features user authentication, CRUD operations, role-based access control, and rich text editing.

name: GreenBasket — Grocery Store
desc: A full-featured grocery e-commerce platform built with PHP and MySQL. Includes product management, order tracking, user authentication, and admin analytics dashboard.

name: Plant Species Identifier using CNN
desc: Plant Species Identification using Convolutional Neural Networks. Built with TensorFlow and Keras for training the deep learning model on plant image datasets.

name: Turtle Race Game
desc: An interactive turtle race game built with Python's turtle graphics library. Players can bet on turtles and watch a simulated race with randomized movement.

name: Secure Password Generator
desc: A secure password generator with GUI built using Python's Tkinter. Generates strong, customizable passwords and stores them securely using JSON-based encryption.

name: Snake Game
desc: A classic snake game built using JavaScript and HTML Canvas. Features smooth gameplay with high score persistence using local storage.

name: Student Satisfaction Survey
desc: A web application for collecting and analyzing student satisfaction feedback. Built with clean UI for easy survey submission and data visualization.

name: Brand Page Website
desc: A responsive brand page website built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features modern design patterns with smooth animations and interactive elements.
